## North Star review

- [ ] The design makes the subject more specific.
- [ ] The hierarchy tells the reader where to look first and what to do next.
- [ ] Photography provides evidence rather than atmosphere alone.
- [ ] Captions, credits, dates, and locations strengthen the work.
- [ ] Mobile has an intentional crop, focal point, and sequence.
- [ ] The page still unmistakably belongs to the Preston Wimberly Oxblood portfolio.
- [ ] I tested whether removing an effect would improve the page.

## Portfolio and implementation QA

- [ ] Existing embedded fonts, licensing fallbacks, and useful components are preserved.
- [ ] No RRL or Texas Monthly font, mark, copy, photograph, or layout is copied.
- [ ] New CSS uses semantic aliases in `app/globals.css` where practical.
- [ ] Role, ownership, collaborators, dates, client attribution, outcomes, metrics, and leadership scope are verified; nothing is implied beyond the record.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation, visible focus, contrast, labels, and 44px touch targets are preserved.
- [ ] Reduced motion, responsive images, and desktop/mobile layouts were checked.
- [ ] Images have dimensions, useful alt text, responsive formats, permissions, and source/credit notes.
- [ ] `npm run quality` passes, or exceptions are recorded below.
